> **Description:**
> Plugin for AIOStreams; it consolidates multiple Stremio addons and debrid services -  including its own suite of built-in addons - into a single, highly customisable super-addon. Supports multi-debrid, usenet streaming (via nzbdav, Altmount, or StremThru Newz), and highly customisable filtering, sorting, and result formatting.
> 
> **Additional Notes:**
> You will need an existing [AIOStreams](<https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams>) manifest URL, which you can get from any [public instance](<https://docs.aiostreams.viren070.me/getting-started/public-instances/>) (or you can [self-host](<https://docs.aiostreams.viren070.me/getting-started/deployment/>)).
> 
> This plugin adds its own results screen that retains all of AIOStreams' sorting and formatting. You can configure the preferred player (built-in, desktop media player, or external player link), adjust trigger locations (episode context menus, detail menus, or a button on the anime page), and control auto-play behaviour.
> 
> Supports any URL or P2P-based stream. 
>

> **Extension Name:**
> Stremio Catalog
> 
> **Version:**
> 0.8.1
> 
> **GitHub Repository / Download Link:**
>  [Click Here](<https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams/releases/download/seanime-extensions-latest/stremio-custom-source-manifest.json>) / Copy the link below:
>  ```https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams/releases/download/seanime-extensions-latest/stremio-custom-source-manifest.json```
> 
> **Description:**
> Exposes Stremio addon catalogues as Seanime custom sources - can be used for anime catalogues as well as standard movie/series ones. The AIOStreams plugin can provide streams for media from this source.
> 
> **Additional Notes:**
> This extension will only support a single Stremio catalogue at a time, and you will need to obtain the catalogue ID and type from the Stremio manifest.json. 
> 
> However, installing via AIOStreams will let you automatically generate different extensions for each catalogue from an addon via a guided setup flow which you can then install all at once into Seanime.
> 
> You will need an existing [AIOStreams](<https://github.com/Viren070/AIOStreams>) instance, available from any [public instance](<https://docs.aiostreams.viren070.me/getting-started/public-instances/>) or by [self-hosting](<https://docs.aiostreams.viren070.me/getting-started/deployment/>).
> 
> For setup instructions, see the [documentation](<https://docs.aiostreams.viren070.me/guides/seanime/>).
